command: pre-registration: reads C and D on the break atlas (docs/BREAK_ATLAS.md 8)

metrics.C_mapping: VLA HANDOFF episodes ending within 0.10 m, familiar, per model; an episode is a missed carry iff over half its object travel after the last held step is lifted >= 0.01 m, gripper commanded closed, within the median held gap + 0.02 m. Share > 2/3 MISSED CARRY; < 1/3 REAL DROP; else MIXED
metrics.D_mapping: new layout, per object (four tasks each), per state, grasp-failure rate for servo and P_min; L both >= 0.9, C both <= 0.1; OBJECT-STATE LOCKED iff for both objects |L| >= 6 and |L| + |C| >= 16; else NOT LOCKED
metrics.labelled: post hoc; development read of recorded tracks; changes no registered verdict
metrics.prediction: C REAL DROP on pi0.5; D OBJECT-STATE LOCKED
